audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical gameplay crop with a persistent top ranking overlay and clean transition cuts matching action beats.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist, clean black and white dialogue subtitles anchored near the bottom third, featuring bold text highlights on punchlines and exact sync with character dialogue.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Dynamic camera tracking following high-speed stunt vehicles, cutting to cinematic reaction angles at the exact moment of comedic impact.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Heavy reliance on iconic in-game audio dialogue ('Davey, how you doing?') looping as a comedic motif, paired with crunchy vehicle crashes and explosions.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Escalating progression structure from simple stunt fails to increasingly chaotic skydiving and jet maneuvers, holding on ragdoll aftermaths for maximum comedic timing.
standout_techniques: Persistent on-screen ranking list (Top 5) that dynamically updates as clips progress
Looping dialogue soundbites timed precisely to character actions and crashes
Escalating comedic structure where each clip out-scales the previous one
Clean audio ducking allowing in-game dialogue to cut through background chaos
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Cluttered or overlapping subtitle text during high-speed action sequences
